rows.text: Consolidate the plan around the AI-only correction; preserve the previous checklist and original evidence. This document and its history copy are the deliverable.

Revalidate the baseline revision, private corpus presence, latest source inventory hashes and V28 validation. Record any current drift before experiments; do not silently inherit stale numbers. Verified in [Wave A baseline/cost receipt](../log/wave-a-baseline-cost-2026-09-08.json): 1,830 tests /158 files /zero skipped; all4,357 current source hashes match.

Write a machine-readable acceptance contract encoding section3, pairing rules, calibrated score anchors, permitted uncertainty and terminal states. Extend the existing qualification/report modules rather than introducing a parallel evaluator.

Reconcile the cost ledger and reservations; distinguish current-round spend, historical campaigns, native subscription calls and unknown charges. Reserve the next bounded wave before any paid call. [Current reconciliation and bounded intents](../log/wave-e-cost-reconciliation-2026-09-08.json).

Inventory code versus staging-only experiments. Identify every helper needed for execution that currently exists only in `.staging`; promote only required, verified behavior into canonical modules with named tests. A157 launch guards and A155 inline transport are candidates for review, not automatic default changes. Receipt: [D386](../log/wave-bv-staging-promotion-disposition-2026-09-08.json).

Remove contradictory instructions from active author/reviewer prompts and skill payloads: filled paint is not always mechanical outline expansion; mixed solid/detail roles exist; host curves are not all grid-snapped; compiler correction is separate from visual repair. Preserve historical receipts rather than editing their prompts. Verified against the actual bundled skill, generated prompts and tool execution in [Wave A integration](../log/wave-a-integration-2026-09-08.json).

Generate one canonical launch descriptor and execute it directly. Bind executable, script/entry point, arguments, working directory, concurrency, model, effort, config, source closure, Node/dependencies, compiler, spec, parts, retrieval and attachment identities. Reject A157-style descriptor/actual-dispatch disagreement before a call. Verified executable integration: [D395](../log/wave-by-runtime-closure-audit-2026-09-08.json); P4 visual route selection remains open.

Put the outer generator under the owned-process boundary. `local-campaign.ts` currently calls `spawnSync` without a timeout, while `local-generate.ts` starts its clock after startup. Pass one parent-issued absolute deadline through the entire request, reserve teardown/receipt margin, and have the parent record failure if the child hangs or emits no valid terminal. Test late receipts, malformed JSON, missing receipt and cleanup failure. No child may create a fresh deadline. Closed with owned-parent, cold-start, invalid/late receipt and unproven-settlement evidence ([D343](../log/wave-bj-parent-deadline-closure-2026-09-08.json)).

Verify installed native capability with the smallest exact-image structured-output smoke test. Freeze actual emitted model identity; reject unsupported CLI versions, aliases that resolve differently, missing attachments or tool-use violations. Never silently switch runtime/model mid-campaign. [Installed capability audit](../log/wave-m-adapter-capability-audit-2026-09-08.json): four exact-image model checks; Claude auxiliary Haiku usage remains unresolved. This does not qualify reviewers, independence or the complete current campaign.

Close detached-descendant containment. Either run the actual authenticated native route in the verified container boundary, or implement and demonstrate a macOS ownership boundary that survives `setsid`, double fork, reparenting and between-sample detachment. Process-group plus observed-descendant tracking alone cannot close this task. Container alternative evidenced in [D240](../log/wave-e-containment-decision-2026-09-08.json); host ownership and salvage remain unproven.

On timeout/cancellation, stop descendants, await proven quiescence, then hash artifacts. A timed-out container probe is not salvage evidence; an escaped writer or uncertain ownership makes artifacts ineligible. Verify no writes after settlement.

Prove the complete state machine: construct → host compile/check → author image inspection → receipt finalization → independent review → named repair or clarification → final validation. Missing paperwork requests finalization only; reviewer uncertainty requests evidence only.

Allocate stage reserves once from the original request deadline. Charge cold retrieval, auth, author calls, inspection, reviewer calls, clarification, repair and final export to it. Consolidate the differing structured-author and style-run reserve calculations into one contract; refuse an inadmissible stage instead of launching a nominal1ms attempt. Keep compiler and visual retries separately bounded; account for up to6 native author calls with compiler1/visual1. A late retry cannot reset the clock.

Recover a valid finalized interrupted candidate despite nonzero exit, but only after contained settlement, immutable inputs, complete programs/checks, exact inspection and author-review receipts. Complete independent review before the original deadline; retain interruption provenance. Reject tampering, absent inspection or expired review reserve.

Connect the selected native route to the canonical campaign driver. Eliminate required manual staging runners; verify the exact native path, reviewer path and repair budgets actually used by campaign requests. Verified executable integration: [D395](../log/wave-by-runtime-closure-audit-2026-09-08.json); P4 visual route selection remains open.

Make resume idempotent at every provider boundary, including crashes after dispatch and before receipt commit. Record dispatch intent before launch; an ambiguous in-flight/charge state cannot be redispatched automatically. Verify concurrent resume contention and atomic terminal writes.

Validate failure receipts as strictly as delivered receipts for request/route/deadline identity, process settlement and call accounting. Current `local-campaign.ts:isTerminal` accepts reduced non-delivered receipts before those checks. Bind the whole selected program/proof/check/review tree, reject path/symlink escape and preserve invalid child output as an outer refusal. Allow a nonzero-exit candidate only through the explicit interrupted-salvage contract, never by trusting a delivered label.

Share a latched stop/call/budget boundary across author, critic, clarification and repair calls. The review campaign already has a stop sentinel; generation needs equivalent enforcement. Mid-request STOP or exhausted reservation prevents the next call, marks remaining work unstarted, and settles in-flight work through containment. A max-request count alone cannot bound native calls: the historical six-author/four-review setup allowed10, and the limit must be recalculated from the newly frozen number of review stages, models and clarifications.

Replay the four frozen failures and two successful controls under one current route. Report all12 slots, original deadlines, stage durations, independent review and failures. The old A126 six-request replay is historical reliability evidence, not a current-route pass.

Reconcile all2,221 filename concepts with semantic families, aliases and close-derivative clusters. Preserve every catalog request slot even when aliases share a family. Finish the1,243 unclassified resolver rows or give explicit unresolved dispositions; unresolved split/classification rows cannot support unseen or morphology-qualified claims.

Annotate primary and secondary construction classes from actual images and source structure, independently reviewed by AI. Keep meaning, family identity, morphology and source-support status separate. Add explicit risk labels for counter size, bridge width, tangent/concave/sharp junctions, repeated rhythm, cutter intersections, modifier collision zones, off-axis/source dependence and paint topology divergence. Name matching alone is insufficient.

Freeze family construction rules with real positive/negative examples: silhouette hierarchy; shoulders/crowns/bases; counters; caps/terminals; tangent junctions; repeated spacing; diagonal weight; modifier anchors; host occlusion and optical center. Version measured values and exceptions by master/paint.

Preserve outline centerlines versus filled boundaries through admission and composition. Validate single-part and compound-part placement, rotation, scale, inherited paint, nonzero/evenodd fill and open-stroke expansion. Refuse unsupported semantics explicitly.

Add source-bound local-feature fidelity checks to admission. `family-parts.ts` currently gates aggregate native raster error at1%; a small lost counter or bridge can fit inside that average. Measure counter/component topology and local occupancy/clearance with tolerances calibrated on real sources. Test bell/keyframe/zoom filled counters, bicycle wheels, a narrow connector, organic contours and multi-counter forms at16/24. Antialiasing-threshold uncertainty must stay explicit; aggregate similarity cannot override an observed topology loss.

Finish folder-lock shoulder/shackle and cloud-upload cutouts using minimal reproductions. Preserve host contour, readable arrow/lock, true transparent counters and intended attachment. Trace whether the cause is construction, cutter topology, optical size or reference choice before changing the kernel. Offline folder isolation: [D428](../log/wave-ch-folder-minimal-reproduction-2026-09-09.json) confirms existing clearance cuts recover the modifier; native16 threshold sensitivity remains unresolved.

Keep the existing Boolean matrix and extend only evidenced gaps: repeated/overlapping/connected cutters, boundary crossing, tangency, nested holes, narrow bridges, rotated/curved cutters, rounded joins, infeasible radii, complete erasure and atomic failure. Check connected components/holes as well as native raster contours on light/dark.

Add missing semantic construction operations only after an existing DSL reproduction proves a representation gap. Candidate needs include blended shoulders, deliberate host occlusion or counter-clearance roles. Preserve host-derived curves, parameter bounds, recipes, transforms, exact replay and resource limits. Do not add arbitrary offsets or a raw-path back door.

Define independent native16/native24 rules for counter opening, detail suppression, spacing, stroke/detail weight, repeated-element density and modifier placement. Measure host-derived correction feasibility before exposing a new tier. A generic “make rounder” operation is not an optical master.

Compare source-supported explicit counters, optical simplification and the offline counter-expansion prototype across bell, folder-lock, keyframe, zoom and bicycle. Bell16 currently lacks a surviving counter under the conservative raster probe; expansion alone has not solved it. Promote a host counter operation only after multiple families improve without outer-contour damage or24px regressions.

Wire cross-master review after both masters exist. Allow intentional optical differences while rejecting changed meaning, shifted modifier identity, missing repeated elements and unstable family layout. Native proof dimensions and artifact hashes must be verified. Add source-bound modifier masks/identity evidence where missing; an `unknown` modifier assessment cannot become family-fit approval.
Calibrate outlined/filled behavior with house controls. Similar silhouettes or deliberately solid outline modifiers are allowed when house-consistent; paint-difference metrics remain advisory.

Prioritize source fixes by blocked generation families and missing useful parts. For each affected source choose `admitted`, `reference-only`, `explicitly-refused` or a demonstrated construction alternative. Record availability and blockers separately for every family/paint/master, including whether the gap blocks generation or only exact reconstruction. Resolve the95 all-refused families sufficiently for the generation target; do not claim every source format must be admitted.

Re-run the full4,357-source audit after each compiler/importer change against the same source identities. Report improved, unchanged, regressed and refused files; track the overlap of1,007 differences and436 refusals without adding them as separate populations. Require zero supported-source regressions and independent native fidelity for newly admitted parts.

Produce a complete construction board covering all eight classes, both paints and both sizes. Include at least two distinct families per class, with overlapping class labels disclosed, plus the unresolved regression cases below. Record AI inspection and failures; new representation fixes return to this board.

Freeze separate populations for development/calibration, critic qualification, repair qualification, catalog audit and novel batches. Give every canonical artifact, presentation repeat, semantic family and source lineage a distinct identity.

Validate semantic answer keys on exact images with two independent AI identities before the critic test. Recognition is elicited before names, filenames, parts or a revealed target. Define synonyms and an unknown/ambiguous response; fix the exposed P01power-symbol/choice mismatch only in new development revisions.

Calibrate the rubric on exposed house positives, generated positives/negatives and subtle native defects. Resolve critical/ship contradictions and unsupported counts/topology claims. Use exact-image visible-region evidence for clarification; retain unsupported allegations as instrument failures, not geometry defects.

Verify native evidence presentation: unscaled16/24 pixels, matched light/dark surfaces and separately labeled enlargement; no hidden resampling in mixed-size sheets. Bind ordered attachment multiplicity as well as hashes. Run identical-image, reversed-order and irrelevant-label controls.

Require consistent categorical decisions on controls and predeclared numerical tolerance: identical/reversed images change craft by at most1 point and cannot change approval or critical status. Verify house self-comparisons meet the same parity/absolute-score protocol. Freeze any calibration change before sealed use.

Select a critic plus a separately sealed two-model adjudication panel. The critic and both panel models must each differ from the author/repairer of that artifact, and all three evaluation models must differ from one another by base-model lineage. Provider aliases, runtimes, efforts and sessions do not establish independent lineage. Fix `ai-qualification.ts`'s current rule that permits an author among multiple judges as long as another judge exists. Freeze provider/model/effort/runtime/prompt/instrument/session identities; a new session or effort on the same model does not create an independent model. For naturally LLM-generated controls, this may require four suitable model identities in total: author, critic and two panel models. If the independent roster is unavailable, verify an additional budgeted route or leave qualification open. Record shared-provider/model-lineage correlations even when model identities differ.

Ensure blinding in tooling: sealed critic predictions are inaccessible to the panel; panel judgments are inaccessible to the critic; no rationale-sharing before terminal seals. Separate working directories, prompt contexts and allowed artifacts. Where read tools are necessary, verify only permitted attachments were accessed; a CLI route with uncontrolled context cannot claim sealed independence.

Construct at least100 independent sealed stimuli across families and all paint/size strata. Include at least80 naturally generated candidates from distinct semantic families, at least20 per paint/size stratum, spanning real junction/spacing/optical/meaning failures and good outputs. Require at least20 confirmed critical generated defects, including at least5 per stratum, and at least20 predicted generated approvals, including at least5 per stratum. Add pristine house controls and objective injected defects as separate strata. If the critic does not supply enough approvals, qualification fails or the predeclared sealed sample is expanded; never select only its easiest approvals. Confirm injected changes are actually critical; a corruption flag alone is not ground truth.

Run blind packets of at most20 outputs. Collect recognition, craft, family fit, native legibility, named critical defects and ship unchanged with artifact/reviewer identities. Retain incomplete and conflicting judgments. Controls are additional presentations, not additional independent samples.

Measure critic-versus-panel approval precision, critical recall and decision coverage separately from host-defect detection. Compute generated-candidate approval precision and critical recall separately and require both to pass; pristine house approvals and synthetic controls cannot supply those denominators. Also report per-stratum outcomes and supported defect classes. Panel consensus may approve only with complete consistent evidence; unresolved panel rows reduce coverage and cannot disappear from reporting. Stratify by size, paint and defect class. Only a provenance-valid wrapper around `qualifyCriticAgainstIndependentAiPanel` may produce the versioned qualification consumed by production dispatch. Keep its AI-agreement scope explicit. `qualifyAiReviewEnsemble` remains a host-control diagnostic; it currently hard-codes `generalGeneratedCriticQualified:false` and cannot be promoted by flipping that boolean. Add a regression proving a passing ensemble/control receipt cannot satisfy the P4/P6/P7 critic dependency. Collector derivation and contradiction checks implemented in [D434](../log/wave-ck-collector-api-integration-2026-09-09.json); production consumption and actual sealed qualification remain open.

Verify real scoring passes the95%/90%/80% gates and controls. Always-approve, always-reject, repeated-byte inflation, missing semantic provenance, copied reviewer identities and mismatched artifacts must fail in tests and report examples.

If qualification fails, archive the failure, treat the opened set as development and reserve a fresh independent set for the next frozen instrument. Do not spend repeatedly on the same exposed P01packet as if its sample size were increasing.

Complete a fresh matched shared-packet versus independent-retrieval test: six declared families, both paints and sizes,24 outputs per arm/48 total. Use folder-lock, bell-pause, bicycle, cloud-upload, shield-check and a verified asymmetric tool family. Earlier shared outputs from changing snapshots cannot supply a matched control arm.

Compare native Astra and Claude author routes on four difficult concepts at both sizes: eight pair requests/16 outputs per arm. Use identical meanings, admitted packets, specs, reviewer, repair limits and20-minute end-to-end ceiling. Freeze exact installed model IDs and efforts; high versus medium is a separate experiment.

Expand contenders that have no unresolved critical failures and usable delivery to the complete20-family development cohort:40 pair requests/80 outputs per arm. Retain screen failures; no cherry-picked survivors within an arm. If neither clears, return the observed class to P1/P2/P3 rather than declaring a winner.

Compare the best author with localized render-feedback repair and bounded host semantic-parameter search on the same declared failures. Equalize total time/call/search budgets. Preserve previous best; record named defect, candidate limits, topology/meaning guards, failed candidates and all costs. Existing folder-lock parameter-search tie is not evidence of uplift.

Test a10-minute route against the20-minute ceiling with the selected author and frozen review requirements. Prefer10 minutes only if paired quality/yield is equivalent under a predeclared margin: no critical regression, craft delta no worse than−0.5 and no more than5 percentage points lower ship/delivery rates. Report intervals and inconclusive results; do not silently reduce review to win on latency.

Complete a small raster/vectorization feasibility decision: first verify an available image-generation and vectorization adapter, editable output, access and cost bounds. If available within the ledger, run at most four difficult concept-size pairs with both paints. Convert through constrained DSL and the same native/replay/review gates. If no adapter meets those conditions, record `unavailable` or `ineligible` with evidence and exclude the arm; it does not block qualifying a passing DSL route. [Current local roster: ineligible](../log/wave-n-raster-route-feasibility-2026-09-08.json); no converter or bounded image adapter installed, zero calls. Reopen only for a concrete bounded adapter.

Classify each output as target reconstruction, exposed-family composition or held-out-family generation, with exact/near-copy exposure evidence. Target matching can qualify reconstruction fidelity; it cannot improve novel-generation statistics.

Select by qualified AI craft/recognition, critical defects, accepted-pair yield, then total time and cost per accepted pair. Include failed calls and both paints. Native dollar cost stays unknown if unreceipted. A fallback route requires a predeclared trigger, shared deadline and its own evidence; no hidden per-case model selection.

Freeze the selected author/runtime, compiler/spec, prompts, reference retrieval, native rules, reviewer/panel, repair policy, end-to-end budget, concurrency and complete tooling closure. Re-run the80-output development cohort if earlier observations do not match that identity.

Seal20 separate independently AI-classified repairable failures from multiple construction classes, with exact previous-best artifacts, named observed defects and preserved semantics. Development repairs A140/A157 and repeatedly exposed controls do not count as fresh qualification cases.

Give the repairer only the production-visible named defect input, never held-out panel labels or rationales. Add a no-change presentation control to measure reviewer drift; classify unchanged output as repair success only if the original defect was formally invalidated as an evaluation error, and exclude such cases from the20 genuinely repairable failures.

Run the frozen localized repair policy inside the original request limits. A compiler error consumes compiler allowance; a named visual defect consumes visual allowance. Missing receipts and unclear evidence consume neither geometry allowance nor a redraw.

Judge before/after blindly using the qualified instrument and independent panel. All evaluation model lineages must exclude the repairer for that artifact. Require resolution of the named defect, no new critical issue, retained recognition/family identity and no native-size regression. A changed SVG or higher average score alone is not a repair success.

Verify ineffective repair stops: same defect persists, unsupported geometry operation, no remaining reserve, invalid/late artifacts or regressed prior best. Restore the exact prior inspected candidate; preserve the failed repair. Escalate representation gaps to P2 without unbounded retries.

Complete cross-master and paired-paint review for the80-output selected development cohort and each construction-board family. Both masters must have independent artifacts; both must remain legible on light/dark and preserve intended optical differences.

Pass at least16/20 repairs without critical regressions. Freeze results and policy. If changed behavior affects authoring, re-run affected development/critic checks and re-freeze before qualification campaigns.

Produce a measured forecast from the complete frozen40-request/80-output development cohort. Extend `campaign-forecast.ts` for pair-consistency checks, accepted yield, per-stage durations, failures, native calls/tokens, unknown charges, disk footprint, cold/warm retrieval and concurrency overhead. Reject mixed identities, incomplete timing or mismatched paint-pair accounting.

Inventory rate limits and usable native quota; choose measured safe concurrency. Begin at one request, validate a small two-concurrent pilot if supported, then freeze a bounded batch size. Record contention, queueing and subscription-reset effects; ideal serial-time/concurrency division is not a schedule.

Add a separately frozen catalog execution mode with bounded manifest shards to the existing campaign boundary. `local-campaign.ts` currently explicitly rejects catalog manifests and concurrency other than1; do not just delete its development protections. Reuse the selected native route, per-request locks, atomic checkpoints, provider-boundary intents, stop/cancel propagation, budget reservations and complete output states. Verify that the existing development driver handles catalog manifests rather than assuming it scales.

Freeze all4,442 catalog concept-size pair requests/8,884 output slots. Reconcile catalog/source counts and missing paint counterparts. Equivalent aliases may reuse computation only through an explicit identity-bound reuse receipt; every requested slot remains in the denominator.

Finalize the preselected100-family/400-output probability audit against verified semantic families and all eight construction classes. Preserve the earlier selection receipt; if its six coarse strata or unresolved membership are insufficient, append a justified new selection before any campaign outputs are inspected. Include supplemental class coverage where needed, labeled separately.

Generate in resumable batches. Apply deterministic checks, qualified critic review, both native surfaces and honest terminal accounting to every slot. A missing paint makes the pair incomplete; a24 result cannot satisfy16. Check runtime/route identity before and after each call.

Independently blind-review the400 selected outputs in packets of at most20, alongside corresponding house references only after generation seals. Randomize left/right identity. Review every additional flagged/uncertain output; those extra reviews do not replace the probability sample.

Include actual failed artifacts and explicit missing-output tiles in every batch report. Record retry lineage, exact accepted bytes, original deadline, reviewer versions and charges. A catalog reconstruction is labeled reconstruction even if technically eligible for catalog delivery.

Stop new dispatch on a critical regression, exhausted reserve, unresolved containment, corrupted accounting or drifted instrument. Settle in-flight work safely. Repair the cause; invalidate affected evidence by dependency identity and resume only the affected scope under a new freeze. Unaffected frozen evidence remains valid.

Complete all slots and compute per-stratum automated results, independently sampled craft/parity/recognition, complete flagged-review outcomes and family-clustered uncertainty. Report requested-pair delivery separately from accepted-output quality. No accepted critical issue remains.

Audit whole-family and close-derivative exclusions across source files, aliases, admitted components, reference sheets, retrieval indexes, local caches, prior experiments and prompt examples. Extend `quality-exposure.ts` from metadata validation to a complete accessible-input census with lineage. Unknown lineage is ineligible for a sealed claim. Build content-addressed, append-only exposure census receipts chained to prior hashes; resolve mutable-path history and include prior author/reviewer attachments and prompt examples. An independent replay must reproduce the census hash.

Seal two disjoint20-family batches with80 slots each, both paints/native sizes. Balance construction classes, density, composition novelty and modifier use. Keep qualification concepts and target artwork out of generation context until each sealed request is dispatched. Because P6 generates the whole existing catalog first, select P7 families outside the catalog and all derivative clusters it exposes. Verify family/alias/derivative absence against the entire P6 manifest before sealing. If the census cannot supply40 eligible families, prepare additional out-of-catalog concepts and validate them before proceeding; an insufficient pool leaves this gate open. Never call already catalog-exposed families unseen. Keep development agents and earlier batch outputs out of later author contexts.

Define novelty precisely: no exposed family or derivative in this project's accessible generation inputs/history. Closed-model pretraining exposure cannot be verified and is not claimed absent. For concepts without a house counterpart, predeclare withheld style neighbors for family comparison; do not invent a direct corresponding target.

Run batchA under the frozen route; retain all failures and original deadlines. Evaluate recognition, craft, family fit, native quality, geometry and delivery by stratum;20 outputs per stratum requires19 successes for a95% rate.

Run batchB independently with no tuning from batchA. If A fails and causes a route change, A becomes development; retire the affected qualification design, establish fresh seals and qualify the changed behavior before claiming two passing batches.
Produce two separate reports with complete80-slot denominators and family-clustered uncertainty. A pooled160-output average cannot repair a failed batch, paint, size or known morphology defect.
Run final regression verification and exact artifact replay under the release freeze. Verify the full private source population remains available and no corpus-gated tests skip.

Generate one machine-readable qualification report linking every rubric gate to its frozen population, counts, intervals, reviewer/author identities, costs and artifact hashes. It must return unqualified if any required evidence is absent, invalid or failing.

Deliver a local index of actual PNG boards and editable SVG/DSL outputs: development, all construction classes, catalog sample, all flags/failures and both novel batches. Include native light/dark and magnified views, paired paints and master siblings. Rendering an index never counts as completing a missing slot.

Reconcile API actuals/reservations/unknowns and native usage across every experiment; link the complete attempt ledger, including canceled and misconfigured runs. Record total elapsed work, observed latency, acceptance yield and cost per accepted pair where measurable.

Fresh audit reads the implementation diff, this plan, execution notes and evidence manifests. Verify no source/target leakage, fabricated review, missing denominator, silent retry, post-freeze mutation or unsupported score promotion. Fix material gaps and invalidate only affected evidence.

Mark completed checkboxes with receipts and publish the exact scoped claim: “AI-assessed10/10 against the frozen Iconsmith rubric,” with per-stratum results and sampling limits. Otherwise list the failing gates and continue eligible work; do not manufacture a final rating.

tests.scope: D457 integrated tests, both TypeScript configurations, build, lint and diff pass.

dispatch.reason: No automatic retry after D446 refusal; current verified code needs a new dispatch freeze, reservation and capacity check.

openDependencies: Recursive author contributor replay and live seals
External recognition instrument/key dispatch freeze and access proof
Honest terminal and catalog/audit denominator alignment
Independent critic qualification and fourth evaluation lineage
Construction visual closure, catalog and novel campaigns
